lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Commander,

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: I've got something to ask you!

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Which do you like better,

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: mild scents or refreshing ones?
Mild scents.
Refreshing scents.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Oh, really?

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: So that's what you like?

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Thanks for telling me! I'll keep it in mind! ^__^
Why do you ask?

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Oh!

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: I've recently started mixing my own perfumes,

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: and it's way more fun than I expected, hehe.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Sometimes they turn out exactly how I imagined,

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: and other times,

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: I get these totally surprising scents that I never thought possible.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: I've been having so much fun mixing

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: that I ended up with way too many perfumes!

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: So I've been asking around about people's favorite scents,

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: and if I have something that matches, I give it as a gift.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: I wanted to give you one too, so that's why I asked.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: You don't dislike perfumes, do you?
I'm okay with it, as long as it's not too strong.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Okay, I'll make a note of that too!

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: I gave one to Eunhwa and Vesti as well,

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: and they really seemed to like it. ^__^
Eunhwa liked it?

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Hehe, yeah!

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: She even wears it regularly, believe it or not.
... I remember Eunhwa going around spritzing it everywhere, saying she had to use it up ASAP.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: She kept the remaining perfume carefully in a box.
... I also recall Eunhwa sighing, saying it was a real pain to deal with.
... I see.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Of course, she always makes a sour face when I give her one,

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: but Eunhwa never openly admits she likes anything.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: That's part of her charm! Hehe.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Anyway, since she seems to really like it,

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: I'm planning to give her and Vesti another bottle today,

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: and I wanted to bring one for you too.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Would it be okay if I stopped by sometime today?
Yeah, that's fine.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Okay, hehe! I'll come by later then.
I should probably warn Eunhwa that Emma is bringing her some more perfume again.
